command:
gcc -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror pcre-control.c -lpcre2-8 -o pcre-control
valgrind --track-origins=yes --leak-check=full --error-exitcode=99 --log-file=/work/undefined.log ./pcre-control || test $? = 99
valgrind --track-origins=yes --leak-check=full --error-exitcode=99 --log-file=/work/defined.log ./pcre-control defined
valgrind --track-origins=yes --leak-check=full --error-exitcode=99 --log-file=/work/qore.log qore -b --enable-debug pcre-probe.qr || test $? = 99
rpm -q pcre2
